g_choice.choice_required: Whether the documented live get/list_all compatibility contract remains, or is deliberately versioned into detached registry views.
g_choice.classification: same live-alias class at deeper boundary, not a new class; P40 says do not patch channel-by-channel and call the class closed

option_break_contract.effect: Make the whole SourceProfileRegistry boundary copy-in and copy-out with model_copy(deep=True) while holding the lock for register/get/list_all/list_by_family; keep the typed SourceProfile and same profile_id, and retain register(..., override=True) as the only update owner.
option_break_contract.required_companions: Registry unit tests for input alias, get, list_all, list_by_family, snapshot_all, nested mapping/list edits, same-ID override and reader mutation; migrate any in-place caller to model_copy + register override; preserve the stale/not-established candidate-only retrieval tests. Consider the cost of copying a profile on every public read before selecting this option.
option_break_contract.risk: The class docstring explicitly says get/list_all live references are retained for compatibility, so this is an API behavior change even if current inspected callsites use register override. Do not land without owner/version decision and consumer audit.

g_choice.option_frozen_model: A stronger breaking alternative is to make SourceProfile immutable and require rebuilding/re-registering values. It crosses beyond registry alias repair and is not the recommended first option.

option_preserve.bounded_residual: Callers can still mutate profiles returned by get/list APIs outside the registry lock and change the profile basis without register; no uniform atomic snapshot guarantee over arbitrary aliases is established. Smallest later capability to close this is an intentional API-versioned immutable/detached boundary plus caller migration, not a per-caller defensive copy.
option_preserve.effect: No SourceProfileRegistry API behavior change. Keep the observable live references and existing register(..., override=True) update channel.
option_preserve.falsifier: After taking a detached snapshot, mutate the original register input and a prior get/list/list_by_family alias. Verify the snapshot bytes stay fixed while the live registry can change through aliases; verify persistence consumers using snapshot_all do not serialize a mixed alias view.
option_preserve.migration: Clarify docs that register input, get, list_all, and list_by_family expose mutable identity; state that snapshot_all detaches output only and external aliases are outside its atomicity guarantee. For each persisted snapshot consumer, explicitly select snapshot_all if it needs register/override coherence. Preserve currentness/stale rows as candidate-only.

g_choice.recommendation: Preserve the declared live get/list_all behavior until an owner explicitly versions the API. Use register(..., override=True) for updates; consumers requiring a coherent detached registry view must use the existing snapshot_all owner API. Record list_by_family and register-input alias behavior as exposed by current implementation. Do not claim the current lock makes external alias mutations atomic.

next_request.decision: Owner should choose preserve-live API or version detached-copy API before product edits.

next_request.if_preserve: Narrow product candidate is registry doc clarification plus the existing persisted snapshot caller(s) selecting snapshot_all; prove `test_excluded_profile_value_change_is_not_current_or_reusable` and `test_actual_catalog_route_keeps_headerful_generation_candidate_only_after_headers_removed` remain candidate-only, with the source snapshot's same-ID nested mutation falsifier.

observed_contract.documented_compatibility: registry.py states get and list_all retain live-object behavior for compatibility, and in-place mutation of profiles obtained from them bypasses the registry lock. list_by_family has the same behavior by implementation, while its docstring does not state it. register input identity is observable but not separately documented.
observed_contract.get: Returns the stored object under the lock; the returned object remains mutable after lock release.
observed_contract.list_all: Returns a sorted list containing stored objects under the lock; profile objects remain mutable after lock release.
observed_contract.list_by_family: Returns stored objects filtered by family under the lock; profile objects remain mutable after lock release.
observed_contract.model: SourceProfile is a mutable Pydantic BaseModel with extra=forbid. Its nested mutable fields include headers: dict[str,str], dataset_discovery_hints: list[str], and tags: list[str]. SourceExecutionPolicy is frozen. No private SourceProfile attrs were found in the model declaration.
observed_contract.register: Stores the exact caller SourceProfile object under the lock; caller-held input aliases remain connected after return.
observed_contract.snapshot_all: Returns deep model copies created under the lock; this detaches the emitted copies from later replacement and alias mutation, but intake aliases can still mutate the stored object before or after snapshot creation.

pattern_pass.authority_boundary: No law, rights, source-custody, external-currentness, calibration, or publication authority is established by profile registry membership or this prototype. Capability discovery remains candidate-only.
pattern_pass.existing_risk: A partial clone of only get, only list_by_family, or only register input would leave sibling aliases open (P31/P40); a single dataclass demo is a witness, not Product proof (P33/P38); the class-reference census is bounded by full *.py roots and listed complete file sets (P35).
pattern_pass.semantic_test_missing: No actual product test in this pass mutates a SourceProfile returned by register/get/list_all/list_by_family and asserts the registry/snapshot result. Existing snapshot test covers only later override isolation.
pattern_pass.target: One owner decision over all mutable intake and emission channels; preserve a declared residual if public compatibility wins, or copy the full registry boundary if the contract is versioned.
